current: O you who have attained faith, when you stand up towards the prayer, then wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows, and wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles. And if you are in a state of junub, then purify yourselves. But if you are ill, or on a journey, or one of you has come from the place of relieving himself, or you have touched the women, and you do not find water, then intend a wholesome ground-surface and wipe your faces and your hands from it. Allah does not intend to place upon you any constraint, but He intends to purify you and to complete His favor upon you, so that you may show gratitude.
proposed: O you who have attained faith, when you stand up towards the prayer, then wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows — and wipe your heads — and your feet up to the ankles. And if you are in a state of junub, then purify yourselves. But if you are ill, or on a journey, or one of you has come from the place of relieving himself, or you have touched the women, and you do not find water, then intend a wholesome ground-surface and wipe your faces and your hands from it. Allah does not intend to place upon you any constraint, but He intends to purify you and to complete His favor upon you, so that you may show gratitude.

current: And when you are called out to the prayer, they take it as mockery and play. That is because they are a people who do not reason.
proposed: And when you call to the prayer, they take it as mockery and play. That is because they are a people who do not reason.

current: And when no sign comes to them, they say, “Why have you not selected it (for yourself)?” Say, “I only follow what is being inspired to me from my Lord. This is insights from your Lord, and guidance and mercy for a people who trust (in it).”
proposed: And when you do not bring them a sign, they say, “Why have you not selected it (for yourself)?” Say, “I only follow what is being inspired to me from my Lord. This is insights from your Lord, and guidance and mercy for a people who trust (in it).”

current: And the Jews said, “ʿUzayr is the son of Allah,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of Allah.” That is their saying with their mouths, resembling the saying of those who covered [the truth] before. May Allah attack them! How are they turned away?
proposed: And the Jews said, “ʿUzayr is the son of Allah,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of Allah.” That is their saying with their mouths; they imitate the saying of those who covered [the truth] before. May Allah attack them! How are they turned away?

current: And among them is one who listens attentively to you. So will you make the deaf hear, even if they are not using reason?
proposed: And among them are those who listen attentively to you. So will you make the deaf hear, even if they are not using reason?

current: We do not send down the angels except with the truth, and then they are not ones given respite.
proposed: We do not send down the angels except with the truth, and in that case they would not be ones given respite.

current: And indeed, those who do not trust in the Hereafter are surely turned away from the path.
proposed: And indeed, those who do not trust in the Hereafter are surely turning aside from the path.

current: So you took them as an object of ridicule until it made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
proposed: So you took them as an object of ridicule until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

current: So when he came to Solomon, he said, “Are you extending support to me with wealth? What Allah has given us is better than what He has given you. No, it is you who exult in your gift.”
proposed: So when he came to Solomon, he said, “Are you extending support to me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. No, it is you who exult in your gift.”

current: So ask them for a ruling: “Are the daughters for your Lord, while the sons are for you?”
proposed: So ask them for a ruling: Are the daughters for your Lord, while the sons are for them?

current: None of them was there but that he denied the envoys, so the requital became duly established.
proposed: None of them was there but that he denied the envoys, so My requital became duly established.

current: The bringing-into-being of the heavens and the earth is greater than the bringing-into-being of the people, but most of the people do not know.
proposed: Surely the bringing-into-being of the heavens and the earth is greater than the bringing-into-being of the people, but most of the people do not know.

current: “When we have died and become dust—this is a far‑fetched return.”
proposed: “What, when we have died and become dust [shall we be returned]? That is a far‑fetched return.”

current: And the earth – We have extended it, and We cast into it stabilizing (mountain) masses, and We caused to grow in it, from every kind, a delightful pair.
proposed: And the earth – We have extended it, and We cast into it stabilizing (mountain) masses, and We caused to grow in it of every delightful pair.

current: So indeed, for those who have done wrong there is a share like the share of their companions; so let them not seek to hasten it.
proposed: So indeed, for those who have done wrong there is a share like the share of their companions; so let them not ask Me to hasten [it].

current: This is a warner from the earlier warnings.
proposed: This is a warner from the earlier warners.

current: So then, when it reaches the throat—
proposed: Why then, when it reaches the throat—

current: So then, if you are not ones who will be judged,
proposed: Why then, if you are not ones who will be judged,

current: you (all) restore it, if you are truthful.
proposed: do you (all) not restore it, if you are truthful?

current: Then you will surely see it as the eye of certainty.
proposed: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

current: So *ṣalli* your Lord, and devote your offering at the upper chest/throat.
proposed: So *ṣalli* for your Lord, and devote your offering at the upper chest/throat.
